title: Funk Assemblage with Targets
description: Densely layered collage presented in a black frame, combining compact discs, chess pieces, bullseye targets, American footballs, and a top-down warplane silhouette across a crumpled white ground. Fabric lettering reading 'Funk' anchors the lower center amid concentric-ring targets in red, yellow, and black.
composition: dense central cluster on white ground
